blurb: Playhouse Stage Company is honored to serve and help cultivate the arts landscape in the NY Capital Region. From large-scale award winning professional musicals at Park Playhouse in Albany, NY to our smaller more intimate professional musicals at Cohoes Music Hall, to our robust arts education training program at Playhouse Stage Academy, we aim to impact our community every day.
